apportionment.source: Brennan Center, "How States' Seats in the U.S. House Could Change After the Next Census" (Jan 28, 2026)
apportionment.note: Projected change in U.S. House seats after the 2030 census. Brennan Center (Jan 28, 2026) and the American Redistricting Project (Jan 27, 2026) both project from the Census Bureau's 2025 estimates; they differ only on Florida (+3 or +2) and New York (-2 or -1). A projection, not a count: the 2030 census and immigration trends can change it. New Jersey and Massachusetts lose no seat in either.
